insight: A Y Combinator alum founded in 2017; raised a $29M Series B led by Accel in 2024.
name: Nanonets
tagline: AI agents for document processing and enterprise data extraction.
description: Nanonets automates document-heavy workflows — invoices, orders, contracts, and claims — with AI agents that read, extract, and route structured data across ERPs, email, and approval chains. It runs on its own OCR-3 extraction model and can fold in LLMs for agentic pipelines. Offered as managed cloud with VPC, single-tenant, and on-premises deployment options and regional data residency.

modelSupport.notes: Ships its own OCR-3 extraction model; can also route to LLMs in agentic pipelines.

edge: Runs its in-house OCR-3 extraction model plus agentic routing into ERPs, with VPC/on-prem and regional data residency.
pros: Agentic routing into ERPs and approvals
cons: Setup tuning for custom doc types
